title: To Adopt and Extend the Declaration of Emergency in Executive Rule 432 Until April 11, 2026, Due to the Impacts of Federal Immigration Enforcement Actions.
synopsis: Adopts and extends until April 11, 2026, the emergency declared in Executive Rule 432 because of the impacts of federal immigration enforcement actions.

title: Resolution Approving the Oregon Historical Society Levy Renewal Explanatory Statement and Ballot Title.
synopsis: Approves the ballot title and explanatory statement for renewing the Oregon Historical Society levy.

title: Resolution adopting the East Multnomah County Transportation Safety Action Plan.
synopsis: Adopts the East Multnomah County Transportation Safety Action Plan.

title: 2026 Comprehensive Local Plan (CLP) Adoption.
synopsis: Adopts the County's 2026 Comprehensive Local Plan, presented by the Health Department director and the interim behavioral health director.

title: Resolution to Adopt Main Streets on Halsey Street Design Plan.
synopsis: Adopts the Main Streets on Halsey Street design plan.

title: Ratification of Collective Bargaining Agreement 2025-2028 between Multnomah County and the American Federation of State County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME) Local 88.
synopsis: Ratifies the 2025–2028 collective bargaining agreement between the County and AFSCME Local 88.

title: Multnomah County Animal Services Board Resolution related to MCAS fees.
synopsis: Adopts a resolution on Multnomah County Animal Services fees.

title: Ratification of Collective Bargaining Agreement 2025-2028 between Multnomah County and the AFSCME Local 88-4 (Pharmacists Unit).
synopsis: Ratifies the 2025–2028 collective bargaining agreement between the County and AFSCME Local 88-4, the pharmacists' unit.

title: Resolution Declaring the East County Office Building, Located at 18600 SE Stark St, Gresham, Oregon as Surplus; and Approving the Terms of a Lease.
synopsis: Declares the East County Office Building at 18600 SE Stark St. in Gresham surplus property and approves the terms of a lease.

title: Resolution Establishing Multnomah County’s Commitment to Investigate and Provide a Plan for How the County Can Require Financial Assurances from CEI Owner/Operators.
synopsis: Commits the County to investigate how it can require financial assurances from owners and operators of CEI facilities, and to produce a plan for doing so.

title: Resolution Establishing Policies for the House Bill 4002 Deflection Program.
synopsis: Sets County policies for the deflection program created under House Bill 4002. Adopted as amended after six amendments; one passed 4–1 with Commissioner Moyer voting no.

title: Transportation Fee Study Recommendations and Resolution to Update Fees.
synopsis: Updates County transportation fees based on the recommendations of a transportation fee study.

title: Resolution Approving the Project Plan for Construction for the Sobering and Crisis Stabilization Center per the FAC-1 Administrative Procedure.
synopsis: Approves the construction project plan for the Sobering and Crisis Stabilization Center under the County's FAC-1 procedure for capital projects.

title: Authorizing Execution of Intergovernmental Agreement with City of Portland Auditor for Initiative Petition Processing Partnership.
synopsis: Authorizes an intergovernmental agreement with the City of Portland Auditor to partner on processing initiative petitions.

title: Resolution Adopting Rules for Board Meetings and Repealing Resolution 2013-021.
synopsis: Adopts new rules for Board meetings, replacing the rules set in 2013 (Resolution 2013-021).

title: Resolution Consenting to Chair Vega Pederson’s Appointment of Nathaniel VerGow as the Director of the Homeless Services Department.
synopsis: Consents to Chair Vega Pederson's appointment of Nathaniel VerGow as director of the Homeless Services Department.

title: Sanctuary County Ordinance by Emergency.
synopsis: Emergency ordinance recognizing the County's sanctuary protections, setting protocols for how the County interacts with federal civil immigration enforcement, and protecting County resources and data.

title: Sanctuary County Resolution by Emergency.
synopsis: Resolution, adopted by emergency and as amended, recognizing the County's sanctuary protections and protocols for interacting with federal civil immigration enforcement, and protecting County resources and data.

title: RESOLUTION Approving the Multnomah County Library District’s Proposed Fiscal Year 2027 Budget for Submittal to the Tax Supervising and Conservation Commission.
synopsis: Approves the Multnomah County Library District's proposed fiscal year 2027 budget, as amended, for submittal to the Tax Supervising and Conservation Commission.

title: RESOLUTION Approving the Chair’s Proposed Fiscal Year 2027 Budget for Submittal to the Tax Supervising and Conservation Commission.
synopsis: Approves Chair Vega Pederson's proposed fiscal year 2027 budget for submittal to the Tax Supervising and Conservation Commission, with the Board sitting as the Budget Committee. Commissioner Brim-Edwards voted no; the Chair was absent.

title: Ratification of Collective Bargaining Agreement 2025-2028 between Multnomah County and the Oregon Nurses Association (ONA).
synopsis: Ratifies the 2025–2028 collective bargaining agreement between the County and the Oregon Nurses Association (ONA).

title: BUDGET MODIFICATION #D2-001-26: Homeless Services Department Shelter Transition.
synopsis: Budget modification for the Homeless Services Department's shelter transition, taken up under unanimous consent. A first roll call was 4–1 with Commissioner Brim-Edwards voting no; the Board then approved her amendment 5–0 and approved the modification as amended 5–0.

title: Resolution initiating a Gap Analysis of the County’s Preschool for All Program.
synopsis: Starts a gap analysis of the County's Preschool for All program. Adopted as amended, with an amendment from Chair Vega Pederson.

title: Resolution Amending the Public Contracting Review Board (PCRB) Rules to Allow for Greater Flexibility with the Construction Diversity Equity Fund.
synopsis: Amends the Public Contracting Review Board rules to allow more flexibility in how the Construction Diversity and Equity Fund is used.

title: Resolution Consenting to Chair Vega Pederson’s Appointment of Rachel Pearl as the Director of the Department of County Human Services.
synopsis: Consents to Chair Vega Pederson's appointment of Rachel Pearl as director of the Department of County Human Services.

title: Ratification of Collective Bargaining Agreement 2025-2028 between Multnomah County and the Multnomah County Corrections Deputies Association (MCCDA).
synopsis: Ratifies the 2025–2028 collective bargaining agreement between the County and the Multnomah County Corrections Deputies Association (MCCDA).

title: Resolution Adopting the Fiscal Year 2027 Budget for the Multnomah County Library District and Making Appropriations Thereunder, Pursuant to ORS 294.456.
synopsis: Adopts the Multnomah County Library District's fiscal year 2027 budget and makes its appropriations, with the commissioners sitting as the district's governing body.

title: Authorizing Salary Adjustments for Employees Not Covered by Collective Bargaining Agreements for Fiscal Year 2026-2027.
synopsis: Authorizes fiscal year 2026–2027 salary adjustments for County employees not covered by collective bargaining agreements.

title: Approving the Fiscal Year 2027 Fee Schedule for Multnomah County and Repealing Prior Fee Resolution.
synopsis: Approves the County's fiscal year 2027 fee schedule and repeals the prior fee resolution.

title: Resolution Levying Ad Valorem Property Taxes for the Multnomah County Library District, Oregon, for Fiscal Year 2027.
synopsis: Levies the Multnomah County Library District's property taxes for fiscal year 2027.

title: Public Hearing and Consideration of a RESOLUTION Adopting the Fiscal Year 2027 Budget for Multnomah County and Making Appropriations Thereunder, Pursuant to ORS 294.456.
synopsis: Adopts Multnomah County's fiscal year 2027 budget and makes its appropriations, after a public hearing and roll calls on dozens of Board amendments. Commissioner Brim-Edwards voted no.

title: Resolution Levying Ad Valorem Property Taxes for Multnomah County, Oregon, for Fiscal Year 2027.
synopsis: Levies Multnomah County's property taxes for fiscal year 2027.

title: Public Hearing and Adoption of a Resolution Establishing Fees for Building Permits and Other Related Permits administered by City of Portland pursuant to Chapter 29 of the Multnomah County Code and Repealing Resolution No. 2025-049; Establishing Land Use Services Fees administered by City of Portland pursuant to Chapter 39 of the Multnomah County Code and Partially Repealing Resolution No. 2025-043.
synopsis: Sets the fees for building permits and land use services that the City of Portland administers for the County under County Code Chapters 29 and 39, replacing earlier fee resolutions.

title: Second Reading of Ordinance Establishing Safe School Zones in Multnomah County, Oregon.
synopsis: Adopts an ordinance establishing Safe School Zones in Multnomah County, after the second reading was amended on June 11.

title: Moderate-Income Revolving Loan (MIRL) Program: Authorization to sign an Intergovernmental Agreement with the Oregon Housing and Community Services Department.
synopsis: Authorizes an intergovernmental agreement with Oregon Housing and Community Services for the Moderate-Income Revolving Loan (MIRL) program.

title: Resolution to approve a revised Franchise Agreement for Cable Services Between Comcast of Illinois/Ohio/Oregon, LLC, Multnomah County, and the Cities of Fairview, Troutdale, and Wood Village.
synopsis: Approves a revised cable franchise agreement between Comcast, the County and the cities of Fairview, Troutdale and Wood Village.

title: Adopting a Population Emergency Release Plan for the Department of Community Justice Juvenile Services Division (JSD) Facilities to be Implemented in accordance with ORS § 419A.055 in the event that the maximum capacity of the juvenile detention facility is exceeded.
synopsis: Adopts a population emergency release plan for the Department of Community Justice's juvenile detention facilities, to be used under state law (ORS 419A.055) if the detention facility exceeds its maximum capacity. Adopted as amended; a second amendment from Commissioner Brim-Edwards, to section 3 of the addendum, failed 2–3.

title: Resolution to adopt Safer Sandy Boulevard Concept Design.
synopsis: Adopts the Safer Sandy Boulevard concept design.

title: Ratification of Collective Bargaining Agreement 2025-2028 between Multnomah County and the AFSCME Local 88-5 (Dentists Unit).
synopsis: Ratifies the 2025–2028 collective bargaining agreement between the County and AFSCME Local 88-5, the dentists' unit.

title: Ratification of Collective Bargaining Agreement 2026-2029 between Multnomah County and the AFSCME Local 88-6 (JCSS Unit).
synopsis: Ratifies the 2026–2029 collective bargaining agreement between the County and AFSCME Local 88-6, the JCSS unit.

title: Second Reading Labor Harmony Ordinance.
synopsis: Adopts the Labor Harmony Ordinance on second reading.

title: Resolution Affirming the County’s Commitment to the Renovation of the Moda Center Arena.
synopsis: Affirms the County's commitment to the renovation of the Moda Center arena. Adopted as amended at a special meeting after roll calls on eight amendments, several of them split; Commissioner Moyer voted no on final adoption.

title: Appeal of DCHS Interim Director’s decision to adopt the Multnomah County Administrative Rule (MCAR) for the licensure and regulation of Adult Care Homes.
synopsis: Adopts an order on an appeal of the Department of County Human Services interim director's decision to adopt a County administrative rule for licensing and regulating adult care homes. The minutes' summary doesn't say whether the appeal was granted.

title: Resolution Approving Termination of Low Income Housing Development Agreement for 722, 732 and 736 NE Couch Street.
synopsis: Ends a low-income housing development agreement for the properties at 722, 732 and 736 NE Couch Street.

title: Public Hearing and Second Reading of Ordinance Amending MCC Chapter 11.500 – Preschool For All Program Income Tax to Reflect Certain Administrative Code Changes.
synopsis: Second reading and adoption of an ordinance amending County Code Chapter 11.500, the Preschool for All personal income tax, to make administrative code changes.

title: Public Hearing and Second Reading of Ordinance Amending MCC Chapter 11.500 - Preschool For All Program Income Tax to Reflect Certain Administrative Code Changes.
synopsis: Second reading and adoption, as amended and as an emergency ordinance, of a second ordinance amending County Code Chapter 11.500, the Preschool for All income tax. The Board approved an amendment from Commissioner Moyer 5–0 first.

title: Resolution Approving the FAC-1 Project Plan for Design of the Department of Community Justice (DCJ) East Campus Expansion Project.
synopsis: Approves the project plan for designing an expansion of the Department of Community Justice's East Campus, under the County's FAC-1 procedure for capital projects.

title: Resolution Adopting the Multnomah County 2026 Climate Justice Plan.
synopsis: Adopts the Multnomah County 2026 Climate Justice Plan, as amended. Of the two amendments approved first, Commissioner Brim-Edwards's passed 4–1 with Commissioner Singleton voting no.

title: Ordinance Amending Multnomah County’s Comprehensive Plan, Zoning Map and Zoning Code to Incorporate Amendments to the City of Portland’s Comprehensive Plan, Zoning Map and Zoning Code (Title 33) adopting the Affordable Housing Opportunities Project, the Code Alignment Project, the Public Infrastructure Environmental Code, and Regulatory Improvement Code Amendment Package 11; and Declaring an Emergency.
synopsis: Adds the City of Portland's recent planning code changes (the Affordable Housing Opportunities Project, the Code Alignment Project, the Public Infrastructure Environmental Code and Regulatory Improvement Code Amendment Package 11) to the County's comprehensive plan, zoning map and zoning code. Adopted as an emergency ordinance.

title: Resolution Approving a Room-Block Agreement (RBA) at the Motel Located at 4911 NE 82nd Ave, Portland, Oregon.
synopsis: Approves an agreement reserving a block of rooms at a motel at 4911 NE 82nd Ave. in Portland. The Homeless Services Department's director presented it.
